visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Replace the Global Result with a Struct
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Two separate ints are passed in and the answer is left in a global variable. Group width and height in a struct and return the area. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: A rectangle is one thing, so it is one struct. The function returns its result instead of writing to a global, and const promises not to change the rectangle.
